findings.highlight: I do not have any regrets
findings.governingReading: there was no repentance along that path
findings.explanation: A stylized statement about repentance and the path becomes ordinary personal regret.

findings.highlight: My self lost its self there
findings.evidenceJa: 我はそこで自身をなくした
findings.governingReading: there I lost my very self
findings.explanation: The subject and reflexive are split into malformed, nearly nonsensical English.

findings.governingReading: the burned ruins spreading before me
findings.explanation: The aftermath of the fire becomes a field still burning.

findings.evidenceJa: それでも思ってしまった
findings.governingReading: even so, I could not help thinking
findings.explanation: The involuntary birth of Shirou’s ideal becomes detached consideration.

findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になろうとした
findings.governingReading: tried to become an ally of justice
findings.explanation: The work’s defining ethical ideal is again reduced to a pop-culture hero type.

findings.evidenceJa: 生き延びた意味を示さなければならない
findings.governingReading: demonstrate the meaning of having survived
findings.explanation: The singular obligation created by Shirou’s survival becomes multiple meanings assigned to losses.

findings.evidenceJa: 灰をまぶしたかのような一面の曇天
findings.governingReading: an unbroken overcast sky as though dusted with ash
findings.explanation: The morning sky’s fire-linked ash image and total coverage disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: まだ人の手が入っていない広大な樹海
findings.governingReading: a vast sea of trees still untouched by human hands
findings.explanation: Pristine, trackless wilderness becomes neglected maintenance.
A missing space fuses the epithet and class name.

findings.highlight: the usual shinai bag in mine
findings.governingReading: the familiar shinai bag in one hand
findings.explanation: The missing noun after “mine” leaves Shirou’s action grammatically incomplete.

findings.highlight: hard to see more than a few meters ahead
findings.evidenceJa: 十数メートル先さえ定かではなかった
findings.governingReading: even ten-odd meters ahead was indistinct
findings.explanation: The visible distance is cut from over ten meters to only a few.
A missing separator fuses the interjection and command into “Ehhold.”

findings.highlight: there’s personal differences on the alarm
findings.governingReading: an alarm whose effect varies from person to person
findings.explanation: Number and preposition errors make the explanation malformed.

findings.highlight: It was light in my case
findings.evidenceJa: 俺には挨拶程度だった
findings.governingReading: for me it was no more than a greeting
findings.explanation: Shirou’s dry comparison of the shock to a greeting disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: さっきの台詞はどこにいったのか
findings.governingReading: what happened to what she said a moment ago
findings.explanation: The joke explicitly calling back to Rin’s peaceful-negotiation claim disappears.
